wolfram.note: compute-engine's own native Drop with a negative count is a no-op (confirmed on a bare, undeclared ComputeEngine) -- Drop(xs, -3) returns xs unchanged instead of dropping the last 3. Answered entirely through Drop's native collection protocol (.at/.count/.iterator), not a value-returning evaluate, so it can't be patched the way an ordinary head is; needs a new packages/ce-patches file that rewrites a negative Drop/Take count into the other head's positive form (Drop(xs, -n) = Take(xs, Max(Length(xs)-n, 0)), and vice versa), mirroring list-stats.ts's existing UpTo-rewrite trick for Take. Too much surgery for this lane's budget.
